messages:
maria: Heads-up: latest flash-attention merge (commit a1b2c3d) changed tiled memory layout; our fused_attn kernel regressed ~15% on our 2k-token production bench. Full perf matrix attached to PR: https://github.com/flash-attention/flash-attention/pull/123 :eyes:

cheng: Any idea which config? batch size / seqlen?

maria: Repro with nightly image on g5.48x, batch=1, seq_len=2048, kv cache hit rate ~95%. Baseline (flash-attn v1) p95=210ms -> new upstream p95=245ms. nvprof/Nsight trace shows extra global loads during q·k product. snippet:

```
# nvprof summary
gpu_time_kernel_fused_attn 210ms -> 260ms
gmem_loads +18%
```

oliver: Could be our kernel selection heuristics choosing the wrong FA variant for long KV-cached runs. We tightened seq_len thresholds last week. Current routing rule: "if seq_len > 1024 -> flash_v2 else fused" — maybe that backfired.

sara: I ran microbenchmarks w/ paged-attn vs flash_v2 earlier today. Paged-attn wins for seq_len>4096, but flash_v2 best for 2k-4k. Do we have the model shape distribution from prod traces?

maria: Sample from last 24h: 60% requests 1-512, 30% 513-2048, 10% >2048. Regression concentrated in 513-2048 where we expected flash_v2 to be best.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pushed to rgx-cpu-2 with flash-attn@a1b2c3d pinned; rollout: 20% -> paused due to increased p95 in 2 pods.

cheng: Also spotted vLLM's recent patch https://github.com/vllm/vllm/pull/777 — it changes KV cache eviction ordering and increases cache thrash on multi-query workloads. Could interact with the FA change and make p95 worse.

maria: Proposed short-term mitigations:
1) Pin FA to previous release for Hosted + Dedicated.
2) Revert the seq_len threshold tweak in kernel selector.
3) Add per-request kernel selector telemetry (chosen_kernel + measured_p99 delta).
Who can own #3?

oliver: I'll own telemetry. Plan: emit chosen_kernel, backend_variant, and measured_p99_latency as labels; add a lightweight sampling counter to avoid too much cardinality. Will start a canary PR today.

sara: Longer-term: we need a controlled evaluation harness — full 3D sweep (batch, seq_len, kv_hit) + memory op counters. Also open an issue on FA repo with our regression numbers and a tiny repro: https://github.com/flash-attention/flash-attention/issues/456

maria: I'll open the rollback PR and coordinate the pin for Dedicated. Also documenting the failing model IDs in the bug tracker. Add any failing model IDs or traces here.

cheng: :thumbsup: will attach vLLM traces and some Nsight exports to the ticket shortly.
